content: {"reasoning":"The payer returned PR-204 (service not covered under the plan), a patient-responsibility coverage denial, consistent with the noted lapsed eligibility. Prior auth isn't required here, so there's no auth defect to cure; a medical-necessity appeal or peer-to-peer only addresses necessity, not a coverage/eligibility exclusion, so neither would overturn PR-204. With no valid payer coverage and no secondary, the balance is properly the patient's responsibility.","action":"bill_patient"}
